Safety Manager Job at African Industries Group (AIG)




        
    

        
        African Industries Group (AIG) is a diversified global conglomerate with a legacy of 52 years of business excellence and sustainable growth. It is headquartered in Lagos, Nigeria. It has been contributing to Nigeria’s socio-economic growth and industrial development and is equally committed towards the nurturing and development of the local community.

AIG owes its success to the core philosophy of ‘Building the Future Together’. Its business strategy is inclusive, sustainable, and not only benefits stakeholders but also positively impacts the environment and society.
     

            
    



It has been predominantly a manufacturing company, with operational excellence benchmarked to global standards. The group has around 35 state of the art manufacturing plants and facilities located in various locations across Nigeria, creating employment opportunities. Its investment and expansion in manufacturing with the latest functional technology provides long term employment to thousands of Nigerians, for people from across the globe. It also creates ancillary employment for many more.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Safety Manager

Job Location: Odogunyan, Ikorodu - Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Key Responsibilities


	Develop, implement, and monitor Health, Safety, and Environment (HSE) policies and procedures across the organisation.
	Ensure compliance with all applicable safety regulations and statutory requirements.
	Conduct regular workplace inspections, risk assessments, and safety audits to identify and mitigate hazards.
	Investigate workplace incidents and recommend corrective and preventive actions.
	Organise and deliver safety training, induction programmes, and emergency drills for employees.
	Monitor the use of PPE and promote a strong safety culture throughout the organisation.
	Prepare HSE reports, maintain safety records, and liaise with regulatory agencies during inspections.


Requirements


	Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Environmental Science, Occupational Health & Safety, or a related field.
	Minimum of 5 years of experience in Health, Safety & Environment within a manufacturing or industrial setting.
	Strong knowledge of Nigerian HSE regulations and international safety standards.
	Professional HSE certification (e.g., NEBOSH, IOSH, ISPON, OSHA) is highly desirable.
	Excellent leadership, communication, and incident investigation skills.
	Ability to develop and implement effective safety management systems.
	Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities.


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using "Safety Manager – Ikorodu" as the subject of the email.

Fleet Manager (Logistics & Transportation Job at Ascentech Services Limited




        
    

        
        Ascentech Services Limited is the most sought-after Human Resource Solution Provider with its Head Office in Lagos, Nigeria. We have a reputation for satisfying and surpassing clients' expectations through our core offerings:  Recruitment and Selection, Outsourcing, Training and Development. To accomplish these we leverage creating and managing change in organizations by improving efficiency through our proven and dynamic HR solutions.

We are  recruiting to fill the position below:
 Job Position:  Fleet Manager (Logistics & Transportation

Job Location: Benin, Edo
Employment Type: Full-time

Summary
     

            
    




	We are seeking an experienced Fleet Manager to oversee and optimize our transportation and fleet operations.
	The ideal candidate will have a strong background in fleet management, logistics, vehicle maintenance, transportation planning, and regulatory compliance.
	This role is responsible for ensuring maximum fleet utilization, cost efficiency, timely deliveries, and operational excellence.


Key Responsibilities


	Manage the company's fleet operations, ensuring maximum vehicle availability, utilization, and performance.
	Develop and implement fleet management strategies to improve operational efficiency and reduce transportation costs.
	Plan, coordinate, and monitor vehicle schedules, routing, and dispatch operations.
	Oversee preventive and corrective maintenance programs to minimize vehicle downtime.
	Monitor fuel consumption, maintenance expenses, and fleet operating costs, implementing cost-saving initiatives where necessary.
	Ensure compliance with road transport regulations, vehicle licensing, insurance, and statutory requirements.
	Manage relationships with vehicle vendors, maintenance contractors, transport partners, and service providers.
	Supervise fleet personnel, including drivers and transport coordinators, ensuring adherence to company policies and safety standards.
	Track fleet performance using GPS tracking systems, telematics, and fleet management software.
	Investigate vehicle incidents, accidents, and operational issues while implementing corrective actions.
	Prepare fleet performance reports, maintenance records, utilization reports, and transportation KPIs for management.
	Ensure compliance with Health, Safety, and Environmental (HSE) policies and safe driving practices.
	Drive continuous improvement initiatives across fleet and transportation operations.


Requirements


	Bachelor's Degree or HND in Logistics, Transport Management, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Mechanical Engineering, or a related discipline.
	Minimum of 7 years of experience in Fleet Management, Logistics, or Transportation Operations, with at least 3 years in a managerial or supervisory role.
	Proven experience managing large commercial fleets within logistics, FMCG, manufacturing, distribution, or transportation companies.
	Strong knowledge of fleet maintenance, vehicle lifecycle management, transportation planning, and route optimization.
	Experience managing fleet budgets, fuel management, vehicle servicing, and vendor performance.
	Proficiency in fleet management systems, GPS tracking platforms, Microsoft Excel, and ERP software.
	Sound knowledge of Nigerian road safety regulations, transport compliance, and fleet documentation.
	Excellent leadership, negotiation, analytical, and problem-solving skills.


Salary
Open.

Method of Application
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the email.

Job Position: Supply and Demand Planning Manager
Job Location: Lagos Mainland, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Role Summary


	The Supply and Demand Planning Manager is responsible for ensuring the efficient and uninterrupted flow of materials to support production schedules while maintaining optimal inventory levels across the organization.
	The role leads Sales &amp; Operations Planning (S&amp;OP) engagements across all plants and oversees demand planning, supply planning, production planning, and inventory management for Raw Materials (RM), Packaging Materials (PM), and Finished Goods (FG).


Key Responsibilities
Demand, Supply &amp; Production Planning:


	Lead monthly demand review and S&amp;OP meetings while managing the demand forecasting and supply planning process to align customer demand, production capacity, and inventory targets.
	Develop and maintain rolling demand forecasts, production plans, and replenishment schedules using historical data, market intelligence, and validated demand drivers.
	Translate approved demand forecasts and inventory strategies into executable supply plans for internal manufacturing sites and third-party manufacturers.


Inventory Management &amp; Optimization:


	Monitor and control RM, PM, and FG inventory levels in line with safety stock targets to minimize stock-outs, expiries, slow-moving, and obsolete inventory.
	Provide visibility on inventory risks and opportunities, including support for new product launches, phase-outs, and constrained items.
	Ensure inventory and data accuracy by validating AWC, BOM integrity, master data, and supporting periodic stock counts and reconciliations.


Material Planning &amp; Order Management:


	Plan and schedule material supply to meet approved production plans while managing daily order planning and delivery performance.
	Proactively monitor material availability, follow up on shortages, and implement mitigation actions to protect production schedules.
	Collaborate with Direct Procurement to optimize inbound material flow and align volume requirements with planning assumptions.


Risk Management, Systems &amp; Continuous Improvement:


	Identify, assess, and communicate supply chain risks, constraints, and mitigation plans while ensuring clear documentation and escalation where required.
	Collaborate with internal stakeholders including Production, Sales, Marketing, Finance, Projects, Customer Service, and Provider Engagement teams to align plans and execution.

	Comprehensive medical insurance, pension, and other employee benefits.

title: Job Openings at Nikemfol
content:
Nikemfol is an emerging fashion brand dedicated to designing and delivering high-quality, contemporary apparel for modern consumers. We specialize in creating stylish, culturally inspired fashion pieces that combine creativity, craftsmanship, and innovation.

Our brand is built on the principles of authenticity, quality, and self-expression. We aim to redefine modern fashion by blending trend-conscious designs with timeless aesthetics, ensuring our collections resonate with today’s dynamic and diverse market.

We are recruiting to fill the following positions below:

1.) Transportation Manager

Job Location: Ikeja, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time
     

            
    



Description


	We are seeking an experienced Transportation Manager to join our team and oversee our daily product shipments.


Responsibilities


	Plan and supervise the shipments from production to the end-user
	Schedule daily and weekly routes
	Track orders using functional systems (e.g. barcodes and tracking software)
	Monitor and report on transportation costs
	Ensure shipping documents are properly filed
	Report maintenance and repair needs for transportation vehicles and equipment
	Research and suggest cost-effective shipping methods
	Conduct regular safety audits on equipment
	Organize training sessions for employees (e.g. proper use of machines and handling of hazardous material)
	Keep organized records of vehicles, schedules and completed orders
	Ensure compliance with company policies and shipping legislation
	Stay up-to-date with safety regulations


Requirements


	Solid knowledge of supply chain management
	Experience preparing and tracking orders
	Familiarity with logistics software, like Freightview and 3PLink
	Excellent organizational skills
	Ability to supervise and train staff
	Problem-solving abilities
